dataset.label: label
exclusions: onboarding grace period: players who signed up after day 106 (fewer than 14 days of tenure by the day-120 feature cutoff) are excluded
campaign.csv excluded from features (day-180 intervention, out of scope per design/high-level.md)

quality_flags: region is 29.5% null in the train table (raw players.csv: 3521/12000, 29.3%) - above the ~20% risk threshold. Not a data-pull bug (same rate in the raw source); treat as a real 'unknown region' segment in the features step rather than dropping the column or guessing a value.

total_spend, purchase_count, distinct_item_types are heavily right-skewed (skew 3.8-8.2): only 8.6% of players made any pre-cutoff purchase. Consider a binary has_purchased flag plus a log-transform of total_spend in the features step rather than using raw skewed values directly.

feature cutoff was deliberately moved from day 180 (same as the label) to day 120, a 60-day horizon before the label per design/high-level.md - the monkey-mode baseline for this same project found that using same-day features made the task near-tautological (recency features alone got ROC-AUC 0.99). This build avoids that by construction; see 01-data.md.

24.8% of the raw 12,000 players (2,971) were excluded as too new to score at the day-120 feature cutoff (signed up after day 106). This is expected given the exclusion rule, not a data quality issue, but it does mean the model only covers players with at least 14 days of tenure by the scoring date - noted here since it narrows 'scoring population' beyond what high-level.md states in the abstract.
